alerts.title: EMERGENCY WEATHER ALERT
alerts.body:
MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT OF TITAY, ZAMBOANGA SIBUGAY

October 8, 2026 | 12:11 PM

CRITICAL PUBLIC WEATHER ALERT
TO ALL RESIDENTS ACROSS THE 30 BARANGAYS OF TITAY:

Severe thunderstorms and heavy rainfall are currently affecting our municipality, bringing an immediate risk of flash floods and landslides.

🔴 URGENT ACTIONS REQUIRED:
STAY INDOORS: Do not attempt to travel, cross overflowing rivers, or traverse flooded streets.

EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY IF AT RISK: If your home is near a riverbank, low-lying flood zone, or landslide-prone slope, move to higher ground or your local evacuation center now.

PROTECT YOUR FAMILY: Keep children and elderly members indoors, secure your pets, and keep emergency supplies close at hand.

Stay alert and stay safe, mga Kasimanwang Titaynon! Contact your respective Barangay Captain or local authorities immediately for emergency assistance.

alerts.title: MPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
alerts.body:
Mga ka-Barangay ug Kabataan, ang Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) nga gikatakda unta karong November 2, 2026, dili na ituloy.

Gipirmahan ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. ang Republic Act No. 12326, nga nagtakda sa five-year term sa mga Barangay ug SK officials ug nag-move sa sunod nga BSKE sa November 13, 2028.

📌 BSKE 2026 — POSTPONED
📌 New BSKE Date — November 13, 2028
📌 Term of Office — 5 Years

Ang mga kalihokan ug election calendar nga may kalabotan sa 2026 BSKE gikansela usab in line with the new law.

Please be guided accordingly.

alerts.title: LOCAL WEATHER ADVISORY: THUNDERSTORM & HEAT WARNING
alerts.body:
⚠️LOCAL WEATHER ADVISORY: THUNDERSTORM & HEAT WARNING

Location: Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay
Effective: Immediate / Rest of the Day
Threats: Sudden thunderstorms, localized flooding, lightning, and high heat index (RealFeel up to 36°C–38°C).

🚨 What to Expect:
Severe Thunderstorms: Sudden heavy downpours accompanied by lightning and gusty winds are active or expected in the area. This can cause brief, localized flash floods or ponding in low-lying areas.

High Heat & Humidity: High humidity combined with warm temperatures is pushing the heat index well into uncomfortable and potentially hazardous levels, increasing the risk of heat exhaustion with prolonged outdoor exposure.

🛡️ Safety Precautions:
Postpone Outdoor Activities: If you hear thunder or see dark storm clouds building, seek shelter indoors immediately. Avoid open fields and tall trees to stay safe from lightning strikes.

Watch for Flooding: If you live near rivers, streams, or flood-prone zones, monitor water levels closely and be prepared to move to higher ground if heavy rains persist.

Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to combat the high humidity and prevent heat-related illness.

Secure Loose Items: Tie down or bring inside any outdoor objects that could be blown away by sudden gusts.
Apektado: Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay

alerts.title:
A Prayer for Peace and Unity in Titay
O God, Creator of all humankind,
alerts.body:
A Prayer for Peace and Unity in Titay
O God, Creator of all humankind,
We come before You today with hearts full of gratitude for the beautiful land of Titay that we share. As Titayanons—Muslims and Christians walking side by side—we thank You for placing us together in this vibrant community.

Lord, You have created us in diversity not to be divided, but to learn from one another, to show compassion, and to grow in understanding.

To our Muslim brothers and sisters, You teach the path of Salam (peace) and submission to Your divine will.

To our Christian brothers and sisters, You teach the path of love, grace, and following the teachings of peace.

Bind us together in mutual respect and neighborly love.
Help us to look past our differences and focus on the deep bonds we share: our common humanity, our hopes for our families, and our dreams for a prosperous and safe Titay.

Grant wisdom to our local leaders and elders, that they may guide our municipality with fairness, justice, and compassion. Heal any past wounds, dissolve prejudice, and replace suspicion with trust.

May our homes be filled with harmony, our streets with safety, and our hearts with a shared commitment to peace. Let Titay shine as a beacon of interfaith unity, proving that love and brotherhood are stronger than any division.

We place our community into Your loving hands.

Amen.

DASIG TITAY

alerts.title: Pag-ampo sa Gabii Alang sa mga Titayanon
alerts.body:
Labing Makagagahum ug Mahigugmaong Dios, sa katapusan kining adlawa, mopataas kami sa among mga kamot ug kasingkasing sa pagpasalamat kanimo sa tanang panalangin, panalipod, ug grasya nga imong gibubo sa among lungsod sa Titay ug sa matag usa kanamo.

Gideklarar namo ang Imong kalinaw ug proteksyon sa tibuok lungsod—gikan sa sentro hangtod sa tanan naming 30 ka mga barangay. Panalangini ang among mga pamilya, mga katilingban, ug ang matag Titayanon. Gihangyo namo ang Imong pag-ayo sa mga gikapoy, kalig-on sa mga nagkugi, ug kahupayan sa mga anaa sa kalisod.

Samtang kami nangatulog karong gabiua, palibuti kami sa Imong mga anghel aron magbantay kanamo batok sa bisan unsa nga kadautan. Hatagi kami sa hinlo nga hunahuna ug lawom nga pahulay aron pagmata namo ugma, mabag-o ang among kusog sa pag-alagad kanimo ug sa among isigka-ingon.

Kining tanan among giampo ug gipasidungog Kanimo, sa ngalan sa Imong Anak nga si Hesus. Amen.

DASIG TITAY
